To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
Scilab/ Scicos environment can be successfully used for system level design characterization of RF and microwave devices.
Scilab and Scicos can be used as development platform for system level characterization, modeling and simulation of RF and Microwave components.
The use of Scicos environment for both characterization and system level simulations enables an "hardware-in-the-loop" approach for device characterization and simulation processes.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a complete system level design methodology for the design, characterization, and simulation of microwave and RF devices.
a new system level design strategy for RF and microwave device.
the development of an efficient and flexible environment to perform the characterization of microwave devices and circuits.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed platform enables a very efficient and flexible approach to the system level simulation and analysis of RF and microwave systems.
Scilab/ Scicos is a very powerful tool to develop system level design and simulation environment for characterization and modeling of RF and microwave devices.
this platform is an excellent tool to perform system level simulations and to extract measurement based models for RF and microwave components.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the Scilab/ Scicos environment provides a very powerful tool for the development of a complete design flow for RF and microwave systems.

we have developed a system level simulation environment for characterization, modeling and simulation of RF and microwave devices, based on a Scilab/ Scicos platform, which is able to drive a complete measurement setup for the system level analysis.
the system level simulation environment allows a fast and accurate design of RF and microwave devices.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the system level analysis of RF and microwave devices is a challenging problem that needs a multidisciplinary approach and a high level of integration of both measurement and modeling processes.
Scilab/ Scicos can provide a very flexible environment to design, characterize, model and simulate RF and microwave devices and circuits.
a system level simulation environment for characterization and modeling of microwave devices can be implemented using Scilab/ Scicos.
